answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The cedar edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 14 clones produces a signature the quill analysis flags immediately. An attacker must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the vine settlement applies the void retroactively.
